body.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_city) AS city_name_count
FROM customers;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS category_count FROM products;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items
WHERE freight_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY freight_value DESC, order_id ASC, order_item_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE ml.level_name = '黄金会员';

SELECT member_id, points
FROM members
WHERE points IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY points DESC, member_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT warehouse_id, capacity
FROM warehouses
WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY capacity DESC, warehouse_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS coupon_count FROM coupons;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT keyword) FROM search_logs;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS adjusted_product_cnt
FROM product_price_history;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_item_price FROM order_items LIMIT 201

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY review_score
ORDER BY review_score
LIMIT 10;

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC, product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
GROUP BY seller_state
ORDER BY seller_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS total_freight
FROM order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY total_freight DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card') AS credit_card_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'boleto') AS boleto_cnt FROM order_payments LIMIT 201

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 10;
SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS campaign_count FROM campaigns GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY campaign_type LIMIT 201

SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
FROM refunds
GROUP BY reason_code
ORDER BY reason_code NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS total_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 LIMIT 201
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM inventory;

SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM inventory_movements
GROUP BY movement_type
ORDER BY movement_type
LIMIT 100;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201

SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets
GROUP BY category_id
ORDER BY category_id NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS settlement_count FROM settlements GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) AS total_commission FROM settlements LIMIT 201

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1500
ORDER BY product_count DESC, product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(MAX(price), 2) AS max_price, ROUND(MIN(price), 2) AS min_price FROM order_items LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01';

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(t.order_amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_amount
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
) t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000;

body.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date - INTERVAL '89 days' FROM orders)
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date + INTERVAL '1 day' FROM orders);

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS hour_of_day,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_count DESC, hour_of_day ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))::numeric / 86400), 2) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM orders LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_creation_date) AS month, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members
WHERE last_login_date >= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - INTERVAL '29 days'
  AND last_login_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members);

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, seller_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_without_price_change
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM product_price_history h
  WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id
);
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type LIMIT 100;

SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
ORDER BY o.order_status
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_state ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_score
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type FROM order_payments) p
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY p.payment_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_sales_excl_freight
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ca.campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
JOIN coupons co ON co.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = co.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id
ORDER BY ca.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.discount_type, ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_amount
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
GROUP BY c.discount_type
ORDER BY c.discount_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(w.capacity) AS total_capacity
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 100;

SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity
FROM inventory
GROUP BY warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.refund_id) AS refund_cnt
FROM refund_items ri
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY refund_cnt DESC, p.product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0)::numeric, 4) AS refund_order_ratio FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 201

SELECT ps.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(ps.person_product_amount), 2) AS avg_product_amount_per_person
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_state,
           c.customer_unique_id,
           SUM(oi.price) AS person_product_amount
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_state, c.customer_unique_id
) ps
GROUP BY ps.customer_state
ORDER BY ps.customer_state
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ml.level_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM member_levels ml
JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id
JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
WHERE ut.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK'
GROUP BY ml.level_id, ml.level_name
ORDER BY member_count DESC, ml.level_id ASC
LIMIT 100;
